extraction.name: YODAS
extraction.description: A large-scale web-crawled speech dataset integrated into OWSM and cleaned with a scalable pipeline. The cleaned version contains 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The work integrates YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset, and applies a scalable data-cleaning pipeline to address incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments, producing a curated speech dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw/source data consisted of YODAS web-crawled speech data, described as raw YODAS data containing issues such as incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A scalable data-cleaning pipeline was developed to address incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments in the web-crawled YODAS dataset, using public toolkits and CTC-score-based filtering with a threshold of θCTC = 0.10.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper analyzes annotation/data quality by evaluating misalignment issues in raw YODAS data and showing that CTC-score-based filtering improves performance; threshold selection is discussed based on performance trends across test sets.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Public toolkits and CTC-score-based filtering were used as machine-assisted tools for cleaning labels/alignment.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The raw web-crawled YODAS data contains labeling and alignment biases/errors, specifically incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The original OWSM training data was insufficient, and the raw YODAS dataset is challenging to use because of its wild nature, including incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments; substantial misalignment issues were observed in the raw data.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work is positioned as advancing open academic research by improving transparency and reproducibility compared with closed models, while also noting concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility in non-open alternatives.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The curated dataset is used for training speech foundation models for multilingual speech-to-text/ASR, and the released resources are intended to support open academic research.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan a public release of the cleaned/curated YODAS dataset, data-cleaning scripts, training code, pre-trained models, and training logs via the ESPnet toolkit; no update schedule or deprecation policy is specified.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Scalable data-cleaning pipeline for raw YODAS data, including filtering to address incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments using CTC-score-based filtering with threshold θCTC = 0.10, producing a curated higher-quality subset.
